text:
Between 14:02 and 14:31 UTC, 12% of API requests failed with HTTP 502. When users called API endpoints, they saw intermittent errors. At 14:27 UTC, we reverted the deploy that introduced the problem. After the revert, error rates returned to normal by 14:31 UTC.

The cause was a deploy that removed the cache warmup step. Without this step, new application instances sent cold traffic to backend services. Some backend services exceeded their connection limits and returned HTTP 502. We restored the cache warmup step in the release process. This release check stops a deploy when this step is absent.
